# Link

> Words that take you somewhere, underlined with a border so the line colours and animates on its own.

Part of the [Nate Mills Design System](../README.md). It is a CSS class API, not a JavaScript component, so its props are the classes and HTML attributes below. Link the stylesheets as [Getting started](../foundations/getting-started.md) shows, then add the classes. Every component: [Components](README.md).

**Element:** `<a href>`

**Classes:** `.link-underline`, `.link-underline--prose`, `.link-underline--icon`, `.icon-size-xs`

## When to use

- A destination inside running text: `.link-underline--prose`.
- A standalone text link, such as "Verify the credential": the base `.link-underline`.
- A text link with a trailing glyph: `.link-underline--icon`, with `.icon-size-xs` on the glyph.

## When not to use

- An action on this page: use a Button.
- The main call to action of a section: use a Button.

## Alternatives

- **[Button](button.md):** A link navigates, a button acts. A standalone call to action that must stand out is a Button styled on an `<a>`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | modifier class | `prose` (`.link-underline--prose`), `icon` (`.link-underline--icon`) | No class: a standalone underlined link. | Where the link sits. |
| `href` | attribute, URL | Any URL | None. Required. | Where the link goes. |
| `target` | attribute | `_blank` | Absent: opens in the same tab. | Set on every link that leaves the site, with `rel`. |
| `rel` | attribute | `noopener noreferrer` | Absent. | Required with `target="_blank"`. |

## Variants

Available variants: `prose`, `icon`.

- `prose` (`.link-underline--prose`): Inside body copy.
- `icon` (`.link-underline--icon`): Carries a trailing glyph, which takes `.icon-size-xs`.

Default variant: No class: a standalone underlined link.

## States

The CSS styles these states: `:focus-visible`, `:hover`.

## Invalid combinations

- A text-decoration underline and the border underline on one link: they render as a double line.
- `.icon-size-xs` outside `.link-underline--icon`: it does nothing there.
- A glyph inside `.link-underline--icon` without `.icon-size-xs`: it renders unsized.
- The `external-link` box glyph on any link: the trailing glyph is `arrow-up-right`.

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Moves focus to the link and shows the focus ring. |
| Shift + Tab | Moves focus back to the previous control. |
| Enter | Follows the link. |
| Space | Scrolls the page; it does not follow a link. |

The CSS adds no key handling; these are the native keys of `<a href>`.

## Rules

| Level | Rule | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| MUST | Render exactly one underline in every state. | Automated: underline gate, every link in every state in a real browser |
| MUST | Give a link that leaves the site `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, a trailing `arrow-up-right` glyph and a `.sr-only` "(opens in a new tab)" cue. | Automated: external-link lint |
| MUST | Show the focus ring on keyboard focus. | Automated: focus-ring gate, which presses Tab to every control in both themes and compares the pixels |
| MUST | Give the trailing glyph in `.link-underline--icon` the `.icon-size-xs` class. | Manual: design review |

Automated checks run on natemills.me before every publish; the scripts live in the private source repository.

## Example

```html
<a class="link-underline link-underline--prose" href="https://natemills.me">natemills.me</a>
```

```html
<a class="link-underline link-underline--icon" href="https://example.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
  Verify the credential<span class="sr-only"> (opens in a new tab)</span>
  <i class="icon-size-xs" data-lucide="arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
</a>
```

## Look

- **Links** are underlined, `{colors.link}` (ink on light, lime on dark). External links open a new
  tab, set `rel`, and carry a trailing up-right arrow glyph plus a screen-reader cue.
- **Standing call-to-action links** use a real 1.5px `border-bottom` in `{colors.border-brand}` rather
  than `text-decoration`, so the rule can be coloured and animated independently of the text. Exactly
  ONE of the two underline mechanisms is ever active on a given link: a border and a text-decoration
  underline together render as a visible double line. A component that draws its own border must also
  cancel `text-decoration` in its `:hover` and `:focus-visible`, not only at rest, or the global link
  hover puts the second line back.
- **A link with a trailing glyph** is `.link-underline--icon`, and the glyph takes `.icon-size-xs`,
  which sizes it to the label and nudges it on hover. Without that class the glyph renders unsized.
- **Action icons** name what the link does: `mail` for a `mailto:` link, `download` for a file
  download, `arrow-up-right` for an external link. Never the `external-link` box glyph, and no icon
  on a same-page anchor, because it never leaves the page.

Values in braces, such as `{colors.border}`, are named on the foundation pages, starting with [Colour](../foundations/color.md).

## Recipe

The recipe from [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md), one entry per state. Names in braces resolve on the foundation pages.

```yaml
link:
  textColor: "{colors.link}"
  decoration: "underline"
  hover: "{colors.link-hover}"
  external: "opens a new tab, rel set, trailing up-right arrow glyph plus a screen-reader cue"
```

## Classes

| Class | Kind | What it does | Tokens it reads |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.link-underline` | base | base | `--color-accent`, `--color-border-brand`, `--color-text-primary`, `--duration-fast`, `--ease-default`, `--font-body`, `--tracking-normal`, `--weight-semibold` |
| `.link-underline--prose` | modifier | inside body copy | `--color-text-primary` |
| `.link-underline--icon` | modifier | carries a trailing glyph; give the glyph .icon-size-xs | `--space-200` |
| `.icon-size-xs` | base | the trailing glyph inside .link-underline--icon: sizes it and nudges it on hover; does nothing elsewhere | None |
